quote.exact: all the soft jobs are going to the Jews

annotations.note: Antisemitic and anti-Japanese remarks, common prejudices of the time. 'Jap' was the standard wartime slur for Japanese people. Kept as written as part of the historical record.
New LCIs built at Gulf Coast yards trained in the Gulf of Mexico before deploying.

quote.exact: our ship will be commissioned Dec. 25

annotations.note: Close. Tom's crew did pick up its ship at a Gulf port, but a month later: LCI(L)-345 was commissioned at Houston on Jan. 22, 1943.
